outcomes: Service staff can identify the correct customer during an inbound request.
Operations can ingest the weekly customer file without ad hoc repair.
The replacement meets every recurring customer-compliance obligation.

criteria.statement: Service roles can find the correct customer during an inbound request.

acceptance.target: All frozen lookup cases return the same customer identity as the legacy system.

criteria.statement: The weekly customer file imports through a stable, versioned contract without manual column cleanup.

acceptance.target: 100 percent of frozen valid batches import without manual remapping; invalid batches fail with actionable errors.

criteria.statement: No retained workflow or paid dependency relies on the dormant social-enrichment connector.

acceptance.target: No execution or dependency exists across the complete tenant history.

criteria.statement: The replacement produces the required annual customer tax certificate.

acceptance.target: Every eligible frozen year-end case produces the policy-required certificate.

non_goals: Reproduce every configuration option in the legacy CRM.

constraints.statement: The full tenant export and replay corpus must be verified before cutover.

change_control: After lock, append a dated decision to teardown.json; never rewrite the original criterion without recording why and who approved it.
